free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports sampling due to the high-risk PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right anterior mid-gland and the rising PSA velocity of 1.62 ng/mL/yr. This is further supported by the prior positive biopsy result and the significant PSA rise from 4.2 ng/mL to 5.2 ng/mL over approximately one year. The statistical prior suggested biopsy, and the retrieved evidence converges on this recommendation.
